description.value: The Karen Magnussen Community Recreation Centre is a public facility operated by North Vancouver Recreation and Culture (NVRC), offering an aquatic centre, arena, fitness centre, and multipurpose gymnasiums. It runs a broad range of programs including public swimming, aquafit, skating, and fitness classes, making it a well-rounded community hub on the North Shore. Touring cyclists passing through North Vancouver may find it a practical stop given its pool and change facilities, though cycling-specific services are not explicitly advertised.
